champion.tips: FIDDLESTICKS TIPS AND TRICKS If you’re not able to use your Ultimate R to kill the enemy laner, try to roam to the mid lane and assist your Mid laner. Avoid dying in the early game. Tank Fiddlesticks is all about surviving the laning phase and being a nuisance. During the laning phase, keep the wave close to your Tower. This will increase your survivability, make it hard for the enemy to fight you and reduce your chances of dying to ganks.
champion.builds: THE BEST FIDDLESTICKS BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Fiddlesticks Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Summon Aery as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Magical Footwear and Approach Velocity in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Rylai's Crystal Scepter as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Liandry's Torment. For your last 3 items, you should build Bloodletter's Curse, Zhonya's Hourglass and finish with Blackfire Torch. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 51.6% winrate over 186 matches played. Optional Your second option for Fiddlesticks Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Liandry's Torment, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Zhonya's Hourglass as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Shadowflame, Void Staff and Morellonomicon. The skill order for this build is W - Q - E. In the current patch, this build has a 55.5% win rate over 137 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Rylai's Crystal Scepter as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Liandry's Torment as a third item. You want to finish the build with Bloodletter's Curse, Zhonya's Hourglass and Abyssal Mask. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 58.4% win rate across 125 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Fiddlesticks Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Arcane Comet, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch as your primary rune tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Frozen Heart as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Liandry's Torment as third item. The last 3 options are Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap and Shadowflame. The ability order for this build is W - Q - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 58.7% win rate over 104 matches played. Situational Fiddlesticks Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Fiddlesticks build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Fiddlesticks runes page.
